text: …　むこうに　いくつか　しまが　みえるぞ！

patterns.name: 〜が見える
patterns.explanation: みえる says something comes into view by itself, and the thing seen takes が. しまが　みえるぞ = 'I can see islands'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to push your point. みえるぞ = 'I can see them, I tell you!'.
